cases.purpose: Independently install a full syscall mask and a mask missing its final bit; verify canonical rendering and unchanged kernel rules.
cases.oracle: An independent raw-netlink model (struct.pack/unpack of AUDIT_GET/AUDIT_SET/AUDIT_LIST_RULES/AUDIT_ADD_RULE/AUDIT_DEL_RULE against the guest kernel) as the oracle for kernel state, run as root in the initial namespaces of a KVM guest; the snapshot/restore of audit state is done by the same oracle
cases.comparison: Exact full-mask text; near-full mask has 2047 distinct clauses, retains bit 2046, omits bit 2047, and both queries preserve the raw oracle state.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
W=/run/w6-audit; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$W"
/usr/bin/cat >"$W/inner.sh" <<'INNER_EOF'
export HOME=/run/w6-audit PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin
cd "$HOME"
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
OR=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-audit-nl.py
nl() { /usr/bin/python3 -I "$OR" "$@"; }
jget() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.loads(sys.argv[1])[sys.argv[2]])' "$1" "$2"; }
stable() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); [d.pop(k) for k in ("lost","backlog","mask")]; print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))' "$1"; }
SNAP=$HOME/audit-snap.json
nl snapshot "$SNAP" >/dev/null || { echo "audit netlink unavailable: $(nl status)"; exit 1; }
restore_audit() { local rc=$?; trap - EXIT; if ! nl restore "$SNAP" >/dev/null; then echo 'audit snapshot restore failed' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit "$rc"; }
trap restore_audit EXIT
nl flush >/dev/null || exit 1
nl add '{"flags":4,"action":2,"syscalls":"all","fields":[],"key":"oracle-all"}' >/dev/null || exit 1
before=$(nl rules) || exit 1
out=$(audit list-rules); rc=$?
after=$(nl rules) || exit 1
echo "oracle-all: rc=$rc exact=$([[ $out == '-a always,exit -S all -k oracle-all' ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) unchanged=$([[ $before == "$after" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
nl flush >/dev/null || exit 1
spec=$(/usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json; print(json.dumps(dict(flags=4, action=2, syscalls=list(range(2047)), fields=[], key="near-all")))') || exit 1
nl add "$spec" >/dev/null || exit 1
before=$(nl rules) || exit 1
out=$(audit list-rules); rc=$?
after=$(nl rules) || exit 1
count=$(/usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import sys; print(sys.argv[1].count(" -S "))' "$out")
echo "near-all: rc=$rc count=$count last-present=$([[ $out == *' -S 2046 '* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) missing-absent=$([[ $out != *' -S 2047 '* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) unchanged=$([[ $before == "$after" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

INNER_EOF
/usr/bin/systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --quiet "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$W/inner.sh"
rc=$?
/usr/bin/cp "$W/rec.tsv" /tmp/parity-case/rec.tsv 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/rm -rf "$W"
exit $rc
cases.stdout:
oracle-all: rc=0 exact=1 unchanged=1
near-all: rc=0 count=2047 last-present=1 missing-absent=1 unchanged=1
